import { createRoutesContext, resolveOptions } from 'vue-router/unplugin';
import fs from 'node:fs';
const context=createRoutesContext(resolveOptions({root:process.cwd(),routesFolder:'src/pages',dts:'typed-router.d.ts',experimental:{paramParsers:{dir:'src/params'}}}));
await context.scanPages(false);context.writeConfigFiles();
fs.writeFileSync('routes.generated.ts', context.generateRoutes());
fs.writeFileSync('resolver.generated.ts', context.generateResolver());
context.stopWatcher();
console.log(fs.readFileSync('typed-router.d.ts','utf8'));
